screen_promotion.policy: Adaptive v2: productive_walk advances regardless direct/panel performance unless quality/correctness invalidates evidence. The best other complete-screen package advances by five-reference win delta, submitted-gem total delta, then fewer features/name. At most two full packages; no positive-isolate filter.

runtime.engine_pin_limit: CLI has no engine-file option. Version is verified in final statistics; reference WASM is the official map-generator engine, not a claim of CLI engine injection.

limits: Development scores/p-values and native endpoint/rate differences are descriptive after multiple/adaptive comparisons.
Native metric pairs with unavailable fields are excluded and counted, not imputed zero. Submitted/collected ratio is a descriptive per-game ratio, not a probability.
Five-reference aggregate, older three-spar subset and two fixed style probes are reported separately. Style probes are not contemporary top-team evidence.
All-side quality includes candidate games and matched original panel. Caught errors and low-fuel samples are diagnostics; zero reported faults is not zero caught SDK errors.
Sampled cumulative policy counters are lower bounds; absent telemetry is unobserved. A recent-camp death counter is temporal association, not damage attribution.
This report never changes candidates, runs games, promotes a bot remotely, or substitutes for final frozen fresh confirmation.
